const webhookBody = $('Webhook').first().json.body;
const brandData = $('Fetch Brand Data').first().json;
const carouselLayoutsRaw = $('Fetch Carousel Layouts').all();
const blogContent = $('Scrape Blog').first().json.data || '';
const brandName = brandData.brands?.name || 'Unknown Brand';
const brandDescription = brandData.style_prompt || '';
const logoUrl = brandData.logo_url || null;
const brandId = webhookBody.brandId;
if (!brandDescription) throw new Error('No brand description found for this brand.');
if (!blogContent) throw new Error('Could not scrape blog content.');

const layouts = carouselLayoutsRaw.map(item => item.json);

let slidePrompts = null;
let layoutName = 'Default';
let layoutId = null;
if (Array.isArray(layouts) && layouts.length > 0) {
  const layout = layouts[Math.floor(Math.random() * layouts.length)];
  layoutId = layout.id || null;
  layoutName = layout.name || 'Default';
  const raw = layout.carousel_slide_prompts || [];
  const sorted = [...raw].sort((a, b) => a.slide_index - b.slide_index);
  if (sorted.length === 6) slidePrompts = sorted.map(s => s.prompt);
}

if (!slidePrompts) {
  const fallback = 'Clean abstract background: soft gradient, no text, no faces, brand colors only. 1080x1080px.';
  slidePrompts = Array(6).fill(fallback);
  layoutName = 'Default';
}

const prompt = `You are a social media content specialist creating a branded LinkedIn/Instagram carousel.

BLOG CONTENT:
${blogContent.substring(0, 8000)}

BRAND VOICE & GUIDELINES:
${brandDescription}

====================
SOURCE RULE
====================
Use only the information, ideas, examples, arguments, and insights present in the BLOG CONTENT above.
Do not add outside knowledge, assumptions, invented examples, unsupported claims, or content from any other source.
Do not expand beyond what is clearly stated or reasonably implied in the blog.

====================
CAROUSEL STRUCTURE
====================
Create exactly 6 carousel slides.

Fixed slide structure:
1. Title slide (hook)
2. Problem slide
3. Insight slide
4. Shift slide
5. Action slide
6. CTA slide

Each slide must have a clear role and must move the story forward.
All 6 slides must form one continuous narrative.

====================
CAROUSEL TITLE RULES
====================
Create one common carouselTitle for the full carousel.
This same carouselTitle must appear on slides 2, 3, 4, and 5.
carouselTitle must be in sentence case.
Max 6 words.
Must clearly reflect the blog topic.

====================
SLIDE REQUIREMENTS
====================

Slide 1: Title slide
Role: Hook the reader and introduce the topic.
headline: sharp, specific hook (max 8 words)
subhead: explain why this topic matters
visualContext: 2 to 3 short lines explaining blog topic + visual direction

Slide 2: Problem slide
Role: Show the core problem, mistake, or gap.
carouselTitle
heading: clearly name the problem
subhead: explain why it matters
bodyPoints: 2 to 3 concise points
smallCopy: short visual label
visualContext: 2 to 3 lines explaining context + visual representation

Slide 3: Insight slide
Role: Explain the key idea, framework, or argument.
carouselTitle
heading: state the insight clearly
subhead: explain the idea simply
bullets: 3 to 5 concise bullets
visualContext: 2 to 3 lines explaining context + visual support

Slide 4: Shift slide
Role: Show the better approach or change.
carouselTitle
heading: describe the shift
subhead: explain what changes
bodyPoints: 2 to 3 concise points
smallCopy: short visual label
visualContext: 2 to 3 lines explaining context + visual direction

Slide 5: Action slide
Role: Provide practical takeaways or steps.
carouselTitle
heading: make it actionable
subhead: explain what the reader can do
bullets: 3 to 5 concise bullets
visualContext: 2 to 3 lines explaining context + visual support

Slide 6: CTA slide
Role: Close and drive action.
heading: relevant closing line
subhead: connect CTA to the topic
ctaText: must be exactly "Read the full article"
visualContext: 2 to 3 lines explaining context + closing visual

====================
WRITING RULES
====================
Write like a clear, sharp human writer.

Use short, direct, natural sentences.
Prefer clarity over cleverness.
Avoid filler, fluff, and ornamental phrasing.
Avoid generic business terms (e.g. robust, comprehensive, integration).
Avoid unnecessary analogies and metaphors.
Avoid exaggeration.
Do not introduce stats unless present in the blog.
Use American English only.
Use sentence case for carouselTitle, headline, heading, subhead.
Do not use em dash.

====================
CLARITY & QUALITY
====================
Each slide must communicate a clear, specific idea.
Avoid vague statements.
Slides must feel distinct in purpose.
Do not repeat the same idea across slides.
Problem and shift slides must feel substantial.
Insight and action slides must be useful.
Visual slides must include enough context for image generation.
Every line must be meaningful.

====================
STRICTLY AVOID WORDS
====================
arena, arsenal, bombard, boost, breeze, buzz, cadence, capture, captivate, catapult, compelling, cornerstone, convey, craft, crafting, crucial, cutting edge, deep dive, delve, digital age, dive, elevate, embark, engage, engaging, enhance, foster, game changer, harness, hiccups, hone, imaginative, in a world, in today's world, is all about, juggling, magic, mind blowing, navigate, nail, nugget, nutshell, paramount, perfect storm, powerful tool, realm, resonate, revolutionize, scrappy, secret sauce, secret weapon, skyrocket, sneak peek, stay tuned, stellar, supercharge, surge, tailor, tackle, tap, trailblazer, turbocharge, uncover, unleash, unlock, unveil

Avoid filler phrases:
"here's the deal", "here's the truth", "let's dive in", "ever wondered", "picture this"

====================
STRICTLY AVOID PATTERNS
====================
It's not about X, it's about Y
It's not just X. It's Y
That's not X, that's Y
Not because X. But because Y
You don't need X. You need Y
No X. No Y. Just Z
X. Y. Z
And the X? Y
The result? The outcome
Repeating short phrases for emphasis

====================
OUTPUT FORMAT
====================
Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown:

{
  "slides": [
    {
      "slideType": "title",
      "slideRole": "hook",
      "headline": "Short punchy headline",
      "subhead": "Short supporting subhead",
      "visualContext": "Line 1 explaining the blog context. Line 2 explaining the visual direction."
    },
    {
      "slideType": "problem",
      "slideRole": "problem",
      "carouselTitle": "Common carousel title",
      "heading": "Sentence case heading",
      "subhead": "Short supporting subhead",
      "bodyPoints": ["Point 1", "Point 2", "Point 3"],
      "smallCopy": "Short visual label",
      "visualContext": "Line 1 explaining context. Line 2 explaining visual."
    },
    {
      "slideType": "insight",
      "slideRole": "insight",
      "carouselTitle": "Common carousel title",
      "heading": "Sentence case heading",
      "subhead": "Short supporting subhead",
      "bullets": ["Bullet 1", "Bullet 2", "Bullet 3"],
      "visualContext": "Line 1 explaining context. Line 2 explaining visual."
    },
    {
      "slideType": "shift",
      "slideRole": "solution_shift",
      "carouselTitle": "Common carousel title",
      "heading": "Sentence case heading",
      "subhead": "Short supporting subhead",
      "bodyPoints": ["Point 1", "Point 2", "Point 3"],
      "smallCopy": "Short visual label",
      "visualContext": "Line 1 explaining context. Line 2 explaining visual."
    },
    {
      "slideType": "action",
      "slideRole": "takeaways",
      "carouselTitle": "Common carousel title",
      "heading": "Sentence case heading",
      "subhead": "Short supporting subhead",
      "bullets": ["Bullet 1", "Bullet 2", "Bullet 3"],
      "visualContext": "Line 1 explaining context. Line 2 explaining visual."
    },
    {
      "slideType": "cta",
      "slideRole": "cta",
      "heading": "Sentence case heading",
      "subhead": "Short supporting subhead",
      "ctaText": "Read the full article",
      "visualContext": "Line 1 explaining context. Line 2 explaining visual."
    }
  ]
}

All 6 slides must have a clear narrative arc.`;
return [{ json: { brandId, brandName, brandDescription, logoUrl, layoutName, layoutId, slidePrompts, requestBody: JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }], max_tokens: 5000, response_format: { type: 'json_object' } }) } }];
